required.name: Certificate III or higher in Mechanical Fitting (or equivalent)
required.hint: Certificate III/Cert III/Cert 3 in Mechanical Fitting or equivalent trade qualification

required.name: Working at Heights, Confined Space & Gas Test Atmospheres (current ≤ 2 years)
required.hint: WAH/Confined Space/GTA tickets current/valid within last 2 years

required.name: Strong safety mindset, teamwork, communication, problem-solving

positives.name: Current Coal Board Medical or ability to obtain
Experience with fixed plant mechanical components
positives.hint: stacker reclaimers, lubrication systems, bearings, gearboxes, slew drives

positives.name: Experience in projects/shutdowns in coal/terminal operations
positives.hint: shutdowns/projects in coal terminals, port operations

positives.name: History with reputable shutdown contractors
positives.hint: Sync Lift, Monadelphous, Downer, UGL, other shutdown contractors

positives.name: Adaptability across shutdowns and maintenance roles
positives.hint: flexible between short-term shutdowns and ongoing maintenance

positives.name: Proactive safety leadership/initiatives
positives.hint: safety rep, toolbox talks, safety awards/initiatives

red_flags.name: No recognised mechanical fitter trade qualification
red_flags.hint: no Certificate III or equivalent mechanical fitting qualification

red_flags.name: No prior shutdown/project-based fitting experience
red_flags.hint: no evidence of shutdown or project-based fitting

red_flags.name: Missing mandatory safety certifications
red_flags.hint: no White Card, Heights, Confined Space, Gas Test

red_flags.name: Unwilling/unable to complete medical or drug/alcohol screening
red_flags.hint: refused/failed pre-employment medical or D&A test

red_flags.name: Limited availability for regional QLD shutdowns
red_flags.hint: cannot travel, not flexible for regional project schedules
